name: reactions_dispatch_first
why: A reaction is the one target with a human actively waiting on it: you add the emoji and watch for the bot to acknowledge. Queued behind dirty quests it waited for every one of them to finish first (measured 2026-08-08: a trigger sat 4.5 minutes behind three quest dispatches before its worker even started, so the emoji showed nothing and looked broken). Reactions must therefore dispatch FIRST, ahead of every dirty quest, and the fairness rotation must not be able to push them back.

q-aaa-first-alphabetically.context: # a quest that sorts BEFORE 'reactions', so a naive sort would dispatch it first

watches.reason: dirty quest that must yield to the reaction

q-zzz-last-alphabetically.context: # a second dirty quest, so the reaction has to beat more than one
